cases.proves_bugs: BUG-862 (the 'completed' half only: a PIT and a CD run that placed objects and ended by Esc are logged 'completed'; the 'cancelled' half is R05 v2 and the 'refused' half is R10 v2)
cases.title: PIT and CD keep placing until Esc, Esc keeps what was placed, and one U takes back only the last pipe
cases.expected: PIT places a first pit, offers the next, takes a second pit; CD places a first pipe, offers the next, takes a second pipe; each Esc ends it with the 'Stopped' line and keeps what was placed: 2 new pits on layer STORMWATER PIT, 2 new pipe objects, 2 flow arrows, 4 IL texts (18.000, 17.800, 17.700, 17.500) and 2 pipe labels; no New Pit or New Pipe window is left open; the Civil log says 'Command outcome: PIT completed' and 'Command outcome: CD completed' and never 'cancelled' for either; ONE U takes back only the last pipe with its two IL texts, its label and its arrow, leaves both pits and the first pipe.
cases.why_not_unit: The run is a chain of real AutoCAD command instances queued one behind another. Only live AutoCAD shows that the next pick really places another object, what Esc keeps and what one U takes back.
not_automated: The second pit and the second pipe are placed with the real mouse (typed text is lost while CE waits at a prompt). The second pipe's length is not asserted (its label read 1 IN 54 in probe PRH1: the click point is not the exact typed point).
The pit label block and the text sizes are not judged (a look item for Codex).
